metadata.title: Interaction of massive black hole binaries with their stellar environment: I. Ejection of hypervelocity stars

notes: No eligible individual stars: the paper analyzes simulated stellar populations around massive black hole binaries (T:p1-b4, T:p5-b6) and does not identify or perform selection/follow-up analysis of any individual Galactic unbound star; the HVSs cited from prior surveys are not individually identified or studied here (T:p1-b9).
